purpose: Fail-closed config validation red-run evidence: .nift/config.json must reject unknown keys loudly (legacy keys from old Nift, or typos) instead of silently ignoring them.
trigger: Template review found legacy keys (script-ext, backup-scripts, paginate-threads) in shipped template configs that the v4 loader silently ignored; the templates themselves were the evidence of the drift.
fix: ProjectInfo::load_config now rejects any config key outside the known set with a clear 'unknown config key '<name>' error. Known keys: content-dir, content-ext, output-dir, output-ext, default-template, incremental-mode, build-threads, contracts, minify-exts.
guard: tests/config_validation.sh (make test-config-validation, wired into the bh2-test-integrity CI-equivalent chain).
